title: operad assistant settings
description: The `assistant` section of config.json, owned by the assistant plugin.

profiles.description: The assistant's profiles, by name. `default` exists even when it is not written here.

cwd.description: The working directory. Without it: ~/.operad/assistant for `default`, ~/.operad/assistant/<name> for any other. It must be inside ~/.operad/assistant or outside the operad home.

harness.description: The harness a new chat uses when it names none.

skills.description: Directories with a SKILL.md, given to the agent at every reply. A relative path is under the working directory.

access.description: Added to the default access profile: the lists are appended and readOnly can be turned on. A profile can tighten the default, never loosen it.
